The API deletes memos by calling `Store.DeleteMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`.

In `store/memo.go`, `DeleteMemo` first removes `memo_relation` records where the memo is either source or target. It then deletes linked `attachment` records. Finally it removes the memo row itself.
